package uuidish

type UUID [16]byte

var NamespaceURL = Must(Parse("6ba7b811-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8"))

func Must(u UUID, err error) UUID {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return u
}

func Parse(s string) (UUID, error) {
	var u UUID
	// Strip the dashes at positions 8, 13, 18, 23 and decode the 32 hex digits.
	if len(s) != 36 {
		return u, errBadLen
	}
	if s[8] != '-' || s[13] != '-' || s[18] != '-' || s[23] != '-' {
		return u, errBadDashes
	}
	positions := [16]int{0, 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, 14, 16, 19, 21, 24, 26, 28, 30, 32, 34}
	for i, p := range positions {
		v, ok := xtob(s[p], s[p+1])
		if !ok {
			return u, errBadHex
		}
		u[i] = v
	}
	return u, nil
}

var (
	errBadLen    = badParseError("invalid uuid length")
	errBadDashes = badParseError("invalid uuid dashes")
	errBadHex    = badParseError("invalid uuid hex")
)

type badParseError string

func (e badParseError) Error() string { return string(e) }
